description: What the app DID, by action: "events" is the reaction window since a cursor, "network" the requests it made, "console" what it logged. e.g. {"action":"events"}

actionId.description: Keep only events attributed to this action — answers "what did action N cause".

assets.description: List the dev server's own successful asset GETs (modules, styles, maps, Vite plumbing).

filters.description: Event type allowlist — the cheapest way to shrink a large timeline.

limit.description: Cap descriptors to the first N.

max_events.description: Cap the timeline to the most recent N events.

method.description: HTTP method filter: GET | POST | PUT | DELETE | PATCH etc.

ok.description: Outcome filter: false keeps only calls that FAILED, true only those that succeeded.

sessionId.description: Target a specific tab. Omit unless you mean one — see instructions.

since.description: Cursor from a prior act/observe, or a git ref.

urlContains.description: Substring that the request URL must contain.

window_ms.description: Time window to look back, in ms (must be > 0).

name: reticle_observe
